items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: We had two sets of writers: our writers, who were a guy named Joel Silver

ctx.x: Oh yeah. We said that all the time but it was hard to fight city hall. We had two sets of writers: our writers, who were a guy named Joel Silver, who ended up being one of the biggest producers in Hollywood. He did the Terminator movies. I mean he did some movies I know you would know.
